crossRefs.note: The heart of the wise instructs his mouth, and adds learning to his lips.
The wise in heart accept commandments, but a chattering fool will fall.
My son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad, even mine.
behold, I have done according to your word. Behold, I have given you a wise and understanding heart; so that there has…
For your obedience has become known to all. I rejoice therefore over you. But I desire to have you wise in that which…
But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits…
Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools.
Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart; so does earnest counsel from a man’s friend.
You are the most excellent of the sons of men. Grace has anointed your lips, therefore God has blessed you forever.
The Preacher sought to find out acceptable words, and that which was written blamelessly, words of truth.

All testified about him, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth, and they said, “Isn’t…
The officers answered, “No man ever spoke like this man!”

translations.web: The wise in heart shall be called prudent. Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction.
translations.bsb: The wise in heart are called discerning, and pleasant speech promotes instruction.
translations.kjv: The wise in heart shall be called prudent: and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.
translations.asv: The wise in heart shall be called prudent; And the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.
